title: Indian Army Agniveer GD Full Length Mock Test 18 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for Indian Army Agniveer GD. Total 100 questions covering General Knowledge, General Science, Mathematics and Reasoning.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions (General Knowledge 25, General Science 25, Mathematics 25, Reasoning 25).
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Official CEE GD pattern 50 questions ka hota hai; yeh extended full-length practice set hai.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Plassey was fought on 23 June 1757 between the British East India Company under Robert Clive and the Nawab of Bengal Siraj-ud-Daulah.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution as he was the chairman of the Drafting Committee.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Which is the longest river in India?
questions.explanation: The Ganga is the longest river in India with a length of about 2525 km.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The Quit India Movement was launched in which year?
questions.explanation: The Quit India Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi on 8 August 1942.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: Who is the current Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) of India? (as of 2026)
questions.explanation: General Upendra Dwivedi is the Chief of the Army Staff of India (assumed office in 2024).

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.question: The President of India is elected by which system?
questions.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college through the system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote.

questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.subject: General Knowledge
